description: Timeline of detected anomalies from signal telemetry, plotted over time with severity-based coloring. Each point represents a z-score outlier event (>3σ from the mean).

panels.description: Each point is a signal reading that deviates >3 standard deviations from its mean. Severity: critical (red) = z>5 or critical-signal z>4, warning (orange) = z>4 or critical-signal z>3, info (blue) = z>3.

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT signal, AVG(value_num) AS mean, STDDEV(value_num) AS stddev
  FROM signal_history
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
    AND value_num IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY signal
  HAVING STDDEV(value_num) > 0 AND COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT
  sh.created_at AS time,
  ROUND(CAST(ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev AS numeric), 2) AS "Critical",
  sh.signal AS "Signal",
  'z_score' AS "Type"
FROM signal_history sh
JOIN stats s ON sh.signal = s.signal
WHERE sh.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(sh.created_at)
  AND ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 3
  AND (
    (sh.signal IN ('IsolationResistance','TpmsPressureFl','TpmsPressureFr','TpmsPressureRl','TpmsPressureRr','ModuleTempMax')
     AND ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 4)
    OR ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 5
  )
ORDER BY sh.created_at

     AND ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 4)
    OR ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 5
  )
  AND (
    ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 4
    OR sh.signal IN ('IsolationResistance','TpmsPressureFl','TpmsPressureFr','TpmsPressureRl','TpmsPressureRr','ModuleTempMax')
  )
ORDER BY sh.created_at

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT signal, AVG(value_num) AS mean, STDDEV(value_num) AS stddev
  FROM signal_history
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
    AND value_num IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY signal
  HAVING STDDEV(value_num) > 0 AND COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT
  sh.created_at AS time,
  ROUND(CAST(ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev AS numeric), 2) AS "Info",
  sh.signal AS "Signal",
  'z_score' AS "Type"
FROM signal_history sh
JOIN stats s ON sh.signal = s.signal
WHERE sh.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND $__timeFilter(sh.created_at)
  AND ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev > 3
  AND ABS(sh.value_num - s.mean) / s.stddev <= 4
  AND sh.signal NOT IN ('IsolationResistance','TpmsPressureFl','TpmsPressureFr','TpmsPressureRl','TpmsPressureRr','ModuleTempMax')
ORDER BY sh.created_at
